after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.data: Binance spot daily klines (data.binance.vision), every USDT pair the archive lists, delisted ones included; each monthly archive checked against its published sha256; a month that cannot be fetched or checked stops the judge, never filled

gates.book_pays: the book's own mean weekly net > 0 over 2018-10..2024-06
gates.costs_x2: mean weekly difference > 0 with the cost doubled
gates.t: t of the mean weekly difference (the book's net minus the benchmark's net), 2018-10..2024-06, >= the threshold
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total difference

spec.holdout_rule: 2024-07..2026-09: mean weekly difference > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645, > 0 with the cost doubled, and the book's own mean weekly net > 0
spec.question: among the 20 largest Binance spot coins, do the 4 that rose most over the last 21 days beat the 20 over the next week, after costs?
spec.rebalance: weekly, at Sunday's daily close (00:00 UTC)
spec.universe: top 20 USDT pairs by USDT volume over 28 days, among pairs with a close on each of the 90 days to the rebalance; no stablecoins, fiat or leveraged tokens; fewer than 12: no trade
